agent_explanations_oldest_first.text: The combined edit SC is saved: S(1.0) on layers 16 to 19 composed with C(-1.5) on layers 16 to 22, 14 tensors in all. This paired generation on dev_b1, where S alone gave +1.6 ± 2.4, tests whether freeing the loops lets S's plain-mode reasoning gain add up.

The combination is the first candidate with a sizeable effect:

| | Original | SC |
|---|---|---|
| Accuracy on dev_b1 | 19.5% | 24.2% |
| Cut at max tokens | 28.5% | 20.3% |

The paired gain is +4.7 ± 2.6 points (29 wrong→right, 17 right→wrong). On the same problems S alone gave +1.6, in a separate pass, so that comparison is loose. The pattern fits the hypothesis: S moves problems into the more accurate plain mode, and C frees part of the extra loops this creates. This is a single set at about 1.8 standard errors, and dev_b1 was used to pick S, so I'll confirm on dev_b2 next. There C alone gave +0.4 and S has never been run. I'll back the candidate up as /work/best_SC first. A gain of about +3 or more on dev_b2 would support SC as a real improvement worth tuning and then freezing for HOLDOUT. A gain near zero would mean the dev_b1 result was largely noise.
SC is backed up in /work/best_SC. This paired generation on dev_b2 is a second DEV measurement of SC, on problems where S has never been run. It checks whether the +4.7 on dev_b1 holds up.

The second DEV set confirms the direction, at a smaller size. SC gives +2.0 ± 2.4 on dev_b2 (22 wrong→right, 17 right→wrong) with cut-offs down from 29.7% to 21.5%. Pooled over both DEV sets (512 problems) the gain is about +3.3 ± 1.8 points, positive in both, so SC is a credible but modest improvement.

With 35 passes left, I'll check whether a stronger loop component helps before freezing. C(-1.5) freed only about half of the loops. A larger dose could free more but might also suppress legitimate restating. That risk showed in the 9 right→wrong pairs. A teacher-forced screen is the cheap way to see where the damage begins, so I'll screen C(-3.0) alone on the same 750 texts and compare with C(-1.5) (pass 12). If onsets fall much further (say P(onset) below 0.45) while finished answers and references stay within about 0.02 nats per token, I'll run SC with C(-3) on the DEV sets. If the damage grows quickly, C(-1.5) stays and I'll freeze SC.
